item.title: Biangjing Zhengfuzhe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Banana King, Kanoe
  • 発売日: 2023-07-18
  • スコア: 6.14/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 邊境征服者
  • 英語名: Henkyou no Seifukusha

あらすじ

The story takes place in the Norman Empire in the province of Cerrado. After the Norman Empire conquered Keter, the western side of the continent was split in two, i.e. the Duchy of Sarich and of Krosa. After seven years of fighting for the throne, Sulipanaxa defeated all his rivals in Sarich. Having been ruled for seventy years, the Cesteners’ discontent with the Normans grew. The Keter exiles, who had lost their country, also came to the region. It was then that the 13th Legion, “Griffin” of the Norman Empire, suddenly rebelled and blew the trumpet of unrest.

This golden manor is set up to please the men of high society, men can pay money to come to the golden manor, play the role of chauffeur, butler, chef, florist, and even the male master and other roles, like a big family to live in peace with everyone, and every woman can be seen to have intercourse at will.

  • 日本語名: 監禁女王
  • 英語名: Kankin Joou

あらすじ

Saxon Dorian has been summoned to the distant land of Kayt at the behest of its lord, Shena von Kerhya. His mission is to show the people of the empire’s new territory how to live under their new regime. The easiest way to do that is to teach their queen, Shein Kayt, exactly what it means to submit to Norman rule…
